name: Abdul El-Sayed
summary:
Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed (  el-SAY-id; born October 31, 1984) is an American politician, epidemiologist, and academic who is a United States senator-elect from Michigan.
Born and raised in southeast Michigan, El-Sayed graduated from the University of Michigan and was a Rhodes Scholar at the University of Oxford, where he earned a doctorate in public health. He then earned his medical degree from Columbia University and became an assistant professor of epidemiology at the Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health.
